en: A monochrome (blue-tinted) vintage postcard showing a cobbled street passing under a large arched gate in a traditional medina. Whitewashed buildings with small windows and wooden doors line the narrow lane; hanging lanterns are visible. Several figures in traditional North African clothing walk away from the viewer through the arch. Printed captions identify the scene as a street in Tétouan named El-Mexuar, and a vertical note at the left margin indicates the publisher.
